newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SIX-MONTH HARBOUR FREIGHT 16.9 PCT UP IN ROMANIA.
newsitem.headline: SIX-MONTH HARBOUR FREIGHT 16.9 PCT UP IN ROMANIA.

text.p: The volume of Romanian domestic harbour freight transport went up by 16.9 percent in the first half of this year from the same period in 1995, a National Statistics Board report showed.
It said maritime freight accounted for 65.9 percent of the total 29.8 million tonnes six-month volume. The rest was river transport.

Crude oil and petroleum products took about 44 percent of January-June maritime freight, while iron ore and scrap iron held 44.4 percent of the six-month river transportation. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
